overview: Webhook receives project data and public image URLs from the HTML page.
OpenAI analyzes the images using vision input.
A structured JSON report is returned to the page.
The page writes the final result into Supabase history.

project.title: Main garage cleanup – March 2026
project.notes: Need one parking lane open and tools easier to reach.

recommended_nodes: Set / Code node to prepare prompt
OpenAI Chat Model node with vision-capable model
system_prompt: You are a professional home organizer and garage organization specialist. Analyze all provided room images together. Identify visible objects, clutter patterns, blocked floor space, unused vertical areas, and likely access problems. Return only valid JSON with these keys: organization_score, detected_objects, current_problems, rearrangement_plan, blueprint_layout, low_cost_improvements. Keep recommendations practical and budget-sensitive. Prioritize using existing shelves, walls, bins, and grouping similar items together before recommending purchases.

current_problems: Floor space is partially blocked by mixed storage.
Frequently used tools are mixed with long-term bins.
rearrangement_plan: Clear the center first and move all loose items temporarily to the perimeter.
Dedicate one wall to daily-use tools and one wall to bulky or seasonal storage.
Move rare-use bins higher and keep frequent-use items between waist and eye level.
response_json_example.blueprint_layout:
FRONT WALL
  Shelves + long-term storage bins

LEFT WALL
  Tools + quick-grab items

RIGHT WALL
  Bulky storage + vertical hang zone

CENTER
  Clear parking / walkway lane
low_cost_improvements: Use hooks or a narrow rail to lift bulky items off the floor.
Label bins before buying new storage.
Use matching low-cost containers only in the most visible problem area first.

important_note: Make sure the final node returns JSON directly to the browser with exactly the keys the page expects.
